title: Oh Susan
lyrics:
[00:31.39] Oh Susan, call me
[00:36.36] I'll put you out of your misery
[00:41.96] Oh Susan, call me
[00:47.13] We can find out your mystery
[00:52.45] You say you want me, you call me again and again
[00:58.04] But your eyelids can't hide it, I see through your lens
[01:03.52] The fighting and lying, I can't take the pain
[01:08.57] Through your screaming and crying caught up in the rain
[01:19.38] Oh Susan, call me
[01:24.40] Put you out of your misery
[01:29.95] Oh Susan, call me
[01:35.20] We can find out your mystery
[01:40.37] The days get longer, and harder the further we go
[01:45.96] But my patience is shorter as if you didn't know
[01:51.27] For this love I can't take the longer I wait
[01:56.98] I need to go now, I don't even know how
[02:03.93] 
[02:13.03] I see it in your eyes
[02:15.51] The love between your thighs
[02:17.54] When I'm home in your arms
[02:23.60] No longer in disguise
[02:26.23] Unwilling to revise what I've done
[02:31.70] 
[02:56.03] Call me Susan
[03:06.54] Call me Susan
[03:16.54]
